annotations.title: Dig a crate of random records

description: Returns 1 to 10 random records from CrateDrop, optionally filtered by genre (e.g. Jazz, Funk / Soul, Electronic, Hip Hop, Reggae, Latin), style (e.g. Bossa Nova, Boogaloo, Deep House, Dub, Library), decade (e.g. 1970) and country (e.g. Brazil, Japan, Nigeria). Each record has artist, title, year, label, styles, Discogs link and a CrateDrop link that plays it. Free.

decade.description: First year of the decade, e.g. 1970

genre.description: Discogs genre, e.g. Jazz or Funk / Soul

name: dig_crate
